entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ValidationsGenerator CS8785 when AddValidation is called from multiple sites in one project #66650
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries #66649
  • Support C# unions types in non-body parameter binding #66648
  • Improve default Identity email wording for recipients who didn't initiate the action #66643

Closed

  • Some `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.HttpSys.dll` APIs are not available on source-build #63782
    11.0-preview5
  • `TypeLoadException`s on .NET 9 when referencing HttpSys on Linux #59166
    11.0-preview5
  • Reference assemblies for Windows only features are empty on Ubunutu preventing compilation #65931
    11.0-preview5
  • The runtime<->aspnetcore shared src is out of sync #18943
  • Authentication state deserialization may fail on first interactive render in Blazor Web App #66644
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi: Enum type is missing when using JsonStringEnumConverter #61303
    11.0-preview5

PullRequests

Created

  • Add localization support to Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #66646
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix nullable annotation for ElementReference.Id #66645
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Update repo ownership mappings #66642
    needs-area-label

Merged

  • Fix missing APIs in source-build builds and enabled public api analyzer to catch regressions #66588
    area-networking, 11.0-preview5
  • [release/10.0] Write gzip footer for resource-collection.js.gz #66647
    Servicing-approved, area-blazor, 10.0.9
  • Sync shared code from runtime #66633
    area-runtime, 11.0-preview5
  • [test-quarantine] Quarantine DataProtectionProviderTests.System_UsesProvidedCertificateNotFromStore #66638
    test-failure, needs-area-label, 11.0-preview5

Updated

  • Map [Obsolete] attribute to deprecated in OpenAPI documents #66355
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal
  • Fix ValidationsGenerator ITypeParameterSymbol handling #65419
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Relabel perf improvements automatically #66623
    Perf, needs-area-label
  • Implement Cross-Site Request Forgery Algorithm based on Fetch Metadata headers #66585
    area-networking, feature-antiforgery
